## Review checklist

- [ ] I edited `data/resources.yml` (not the generated Markdown) and ran `python scripts/generate.py`.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` passes.
- [ ] The license was read from the LICENSE file at the default branch; the evidence URL is in `license_evidence`.
- [ ] Subfolders, datasets and optional components with different licenses are noted in `license_note`.
- [ ] Open-source functionality is real: nothing listed requires a proprietary service, account or token (or the limitation is stated).
- [ ] Latest release or commit evidence is recorded; the project is not archived.
- [ ] The summary and description are factual: no superlatives, no unsupported effectiveness claims.
- [ ] This is a single canonical entry (no duplicate of an existing project).
- [ ] If the entry is from my employer or sponsor, a `disclosure` is set.
- [ ] Not promotional; no preferential placement requested.
